title: our own ICD — the capabilities the driver itself must get right, independent of any consumer
note: Two kinds of rows: (a) an internal correctness fix that a consumer's requirement depends on (the source match proves the fix is in the tree, the test id proves it is checked); (b) the limits and features we advertise, which appear in every other consumer's `ours` column. Rows here have a source line in *our* tree — the same anti-guess rule applies.
